analysis:
Docs-only change to docs/provider/cli-reference.md. It adds a 'Local GLM qualification' section (head lines 18-60) and touches one more head line at 1716, which is outside the supplied text (units end at line 834). That line is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety.

The new section describes the following behavior:
- GLM is served locally only when DARKBLOOM_EXPERIMENTAL_GLM5_NEXT names an absolute qualification JSON file. Unset, empty, '1' or mismatched values refuse GLM.
- The variable is not forwarded into launchd and never advertises the identity to the coordinator.
- Coordinator-connected serving is limited to catalog build glm-5.3-flash on M5 Max/Ultra with at least 256 GB.
- The encrypted SSD prefix store defaults on for GLM, and DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0 opts out (lines 40-41). This matches T-041's default-on, per-eligible-CBv2-model posture and the kill switch. Nothing is claimed that widens the TTL, the scope or the HMAC naming.
- Inline video (data:video/mp4 or quicktime) is accepted on the GLM media path (line 51). The text does not say how the video is staged. T-050 covers earlier plaintext-video temp-file exposure, and the next pass should confirm the GLM video path avoids temp files if the source is supplied.
- The text states that the opt-in does not qualify the model or bypass memory admission, so it makes no production-qualification claim.

The section does not change any security control or trust boundary (TB-007, TB-011, T-041). It only adds a possible threat-model gap: GLM-specific prefix-cache gating bounds and the video staging path are not named in T-041 or T-050. Existing logout and revocation text (lines 500-549) is consistent with the A-008 and T-053 descriptions. No findings.
